# Kotoba Registry: agent consumption contract

Repository: https://github.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry
Catalog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry/main/index.json
ADR: https://github.com/kotoba-lang/kotoba-registry/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-kotoba-extension-registry.md

## Discovery and identity

The extension catalog uses the Hermes Registry format. index.json is generated
by scripts/build-index.mjs. Skills reside at skills/<category>/<id>/SKILL.md;
MCP connection definitions reside at mcp/<id>/manifest.json. The catalog is
separate from Kotoba's signed CID language package registry and from west pins.

Resolve the registry to an immutable Git commit. Fetch the index and all files
in the selected entry folder from that same commit. Recompute its checksum:
SHA-256 over sorted relative file paths, a NUL byte, each file's bytes, and a
NUL byte after each file. Compare the sha256:<hex> result to index.json.
Do not mix files fetched from different main revisions or treat a checksum as
a permission grant. Inspect source provenance and the entry before installing.

## Forest maintenance

Runtime owner: https://github.com/com-junkawasaki/west-manifest
Command reference: https://github.com/com-junkawasaki/west-manifest/blob/main/docs/forest-maintenance.md
Skill: skills/software-development/github-forest-maintenance/SKILL.md
MCP: mcp/github-forest/manifest.json

Install the owning repository and its documented dependencies first. Put
forest-maintenance on PATH. The stdio connection is command forest-maintenance
with arguments ["mcp"]. The copied server/ files are an inspection snapshot,
not an independent installation of the entire runtime repository.

Copy the whole skill folder, including references/ and agents/, into the
agent's skill directory. Hermes uses mcp_servers.github-forest in its profile
config. Codex and Claude use their native MCP configuration. The owning repo's
scripts/install-forest-clients.py installs these settings while preserving
unrelated configuration. Never store credentials or profile databases here.

Use audit → plan → selected apply → verify. Preserve unrelated WIP, stashes,
branches and broken worktrees. Repository paths belong under github/<org>/<repo>,
task worktrees under github/wt/<agent>/<task>, and scratch under
github/workspaces/<agent>/<task>. Separate west workspaces require their own
.west/config; broad updates of the shared forest are not routine checks.

## Maintain and publish

Run node scripts/build-index.mjs, then node scripts/build-index.mjs --check.
Check immutable source snapshots against provenance.json. Review and merge
catalog changes, then advance only the registry's west pin through the owning
west-manifest workflow. Verify the signed genpon head and named checkout.

Publication does not automatically configure existing Discover consumers,
activate bots, grant tools, deploy software, or qualify distributed availability.
